## 🔐 Security Checklist

* [ ] User input is validated on the server.
* [ ] SQL queries use parameterized statements.
* [ ] Passwords are securely hashed.
* [ ] No passwords, API keys, or secrets are exposed.
* [ ] Authentication and authorization checks are implemented where required.
* [ ] CSRF protection is maintained.
* [ ] Session security is not weakened.
* [ ] Sensitive information is not written to logs.
* [ ] Security-related changes have appropriate tests.
* [ ] Not applicable items have been explained below.
